description: Parameterized column types: DECIMAL(p,s), DECIMAL(p), NUMBER(p,s), VARCHAR(n), CHAR(n), a mixed multi-column table, and bare DECIMAL/VARCHAR defaults (bare DECIMAL has scale 0, so 123.45 rounds to 123 — engine-pinned). Converted 1:1 from types/DecimalTypeTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE prices (id INTEGER, amount DECIMAL(10, 2))
CREATE TABLE counts (id INTEGER, value DECIMAL(5))
CREATE TABLE measurements (id INTEGER, value NUMBER(15, 4))
CREATE TABLE names (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(50))
CREATE TABLE codes (id INTEGER, code CHAR(10))

CREATE TABLE products (
    id INTEGER,
    name VARCHAR(100),
    price DECIMAL(10, 2),
    quantity NUMBER(8),
    discount DECIMAL(5, 2)
)
CREATE TABLE mixed (id INTEGER, amount DECIMAL, name VARCHAR)
